test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In May 2025, six African nations signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the World Health Organization (WHO) to combat Kala Azar. What does Kala Azar refer to?

options.text: A type of viral fever transmitted by mosquitoes
A bacterial infection spread through contaminated water
A parasitic disease caused by sandfly bites
A genetic disorder affecting red blood cells

solution:
The correct answer is __**A parasitic disease caused by sandfly bites**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kala Azar, also known as visceral leishmaniasis**, is a parasitic disease caused by protozoa of the genus *Leishmania*, transmitted through bites of infected female sandflies (*Phlebotomus*).
 
• The disease affects the internal organs, particularly the liver, spleen, and bone marrow, and can be fatal if left untreated.
 
• Symptoms of Kala Azar include prolonged fever, weight loss, weakness, anemia, and swelling of the spleen and liver.
 
• Kala Azar is endemic in several African and Asian nations, including India, Bangladesh, Sudan, South Sudan, Ethiopia, and Kenya.
 
• The World Health Organization (WHO) considers it a neglected tropical disease and has prioritized its elimination in endemic countries through control programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A type of viral fever transmitted by mosquitoes:**

 
 
• Diseases such as dengue fever, chikungunya, and Zika virus are examples of viral fevers transmitted by mosquitoes, particularly *Aedes aegypti*.
 
• Dengue fever is characterized by high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pain, and skin rash.
 
• Unlike Kala Azar, these diseases are caused by viruses, not parasitic protozoa.
 
 
 
• **A bacterial infection spread through contaminated water:**
 
 
• Diseases such as cholera and typhoid are bacterial infections caused by consumption of water or food contaminated with the bacteria *Vibrio cholerae* and *Salmonella typhi*, respectively.
 
• Symptoms include severe diarrhea, dehydration, and fever, which differ significantly from Kala Azar's symptoms.
 
• Kala Azar is not spread through water; it is vector-borne and transmitted by sandflies.
 
 
 
• **A genetic disorder affecting red blood cells:**
 
 
• Genetic disorders such as sickle cell anemia and thalassemia affect the structure and function of red blood cells.
 
• Sickle cell anemia causes abnormally shaped red blood cells, leading to blockages in blood vessels and reduced oxygen delivery to tissues.
 
• These disorders are inherited and non-communicable, whereas Kala Azar is an infectious disease caused by parasites.
 
 
 
• **About Kala Azar:**
 
 
• Efforts to combat Kala Azar include early diagnosis, vector control measures (e.g., insecticide spraying), and effective treatment using antileishmanial drugs such as amphotericin B and miltefosine.
 
• WHO has set a target for eliminating Kala Azar as a public health problem in endemic regions by reducing cases to less than 1 per 10,000 population at the district level.
